_readme: Profiles of the compared models. NEVER put keys here: api_key_env is the NAME of the environment variable holding the key. Replace PUT_... with the exact model names (in Ollama: 'ollama list'). extra_body (optional) is passed to the server on every call, for example to turn off the reasoning of 'thinking' models; check the server's documentation for the parameter it accepts. prompt_language (optional) is the planner prompt's language: 'pt' (default, the measured one) or 'en'. The old names ollama-pequeno and ollama-medio still work.
